based_on: September 4 verified ALAM signals on changing work rules, consumer claims, market rates, industrial labor shortages and new research
question: Kapag mabilis ang pagbabago ng impormasyon at bawat headline ay may hinihinging reaction, paano natin malalaman kung sapat na ang ating narinig bago tayo humatol o kumilos?

verses.text: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
